questions.question: How does the typical sales of Cappuccino compare to the other drinks in the Night column for the same time of day?

answer.value: The Night slice is a tight band: Cappuccino sits right at the top of the pack for average ticket size that hour—essentially tied with Hot Chocolate and Cocoa, and clearly above Americano, Cortado, and Espresso. So the highlight is flagging one of the stronger evening performers rather than a weak outlier.

key_insights: Among Night drinks, Cappuccino’s mean sales are among the highest in the column.
Several milk-based options cluster together near the top; simpler black coffees register lower in the same time slot.
